# Toggle

Select a value between two options providing immediate change.
See [Toggle guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/toggle/design/)

The `ds-toggle` class is a simple container for:

- a checkbox input with the `ds-toggle-input` class
- a label with the `ds-toggle-label` class

<Canvas of={ToggleStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Sizes

The Toggle comes in 3 sizes: large, medium (default), or small.

<Canvas of={ToggleStories.Sizes} />
